source: Reference values copied from temp/benchmark.txt; default benchmark uses fixture data to validate comparison semantics.

normalization.ed_total_NE: ED reports total particle number NE_b + NE_c.
normalization.dqmc_total_NE: DQMC total particle number is num_up + num_do.
normalization.dqmc_kinetic: DQMC file kinetic is accumulated with division by Lq in Obs_equal_calc, so compare kinetic * Lq to ED total kinetic.
